repeatPolicy.rule: Students who receive a grade of “D” or lower in any of the nine required Accounting courses in the Professional Studies Requirement will be allowed to repeat the course only once. In total, students may repeat no more than three Accounting courses for which they received a grade of “D” or lower. Students who exceed this allowed number of course repeats will be dismissed from the B.S. program in Accounting.
repeatPolicy.exception: The Academic Advisor for the B.S. program in Accounting may, under extraordinary circumstances, make exceptions to this rule.
